title: A simpler Enter account page
summary:
Enter account and signup fixes led the day, alongside better caching for repeat text requests and a new community chat listing.

Enter’s account page got a narrower layout and a Pollen balance shown to four decimal places. API key creation no longer asks for allowed domains, key deletion now requires confirmation, and the profile menu provides access to the customer portal and sign-out. Signup also handles accounts whose Polar customer record already exists.

POST requests to the text API’s root path can now use cached responses rather than always reaching the origin. Repeated requests with cache hits can return faster; root-path GET behavior is unchanged.

The llms guide now covers reference images for kontext, nanobanana, and seedream, including the public limit of four reference URLs per request. It also documents nanobanana’s custom sizes and seedream’s high-resolution output.

highlights.title: Simpler API key setup
highlights.text: Create an API key without filling in an allowed-domains field. Enter’s account page also puts the customer portal in your profile menu. [Manage your keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
